title: Export every licensed user with SKU names to CSV
summary: One CSV of licensed users with readable SKU part numbers and account state, so you can spot licenses on disabled accounts before a true-up.
code:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'User.Read.All','Organization.Read.All'

$sku = @{}
Get-MgSubscribedSku | ForEach-Object { $sku[$_.SkuId] = $_.SkuPartNumber }

Get-MgUser -All -Property DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,AccountEnabled,AssignedLicenses |
  Where-Object { $_.AssignedLicenses.Count -gt 0 } |
  Select-Object DisplayName, UserPrincipalName, AccountEnabled,
    @{n='Licenses';e={ ($_.AssignedLicenses.SkuId | ForEach-Object { $sku[$_] }) -join ';' }} |
  Export-Csv .\license-inventory.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
notes: Filter the CSV on AccountEnabled = False to find licenses you can reclaim.
Get-MgUser only returns the properties you ask for with -Property; AssignedLicenses is empty without it.

source.label: List who has which license with Graph PowerShell
